limitations_and_boundaries: Electrophysiological properties (including LTP) were not changed at 5 days after injection of C1q antibodies.
Multiple other changes induced by tauopathy in the PSD might not be fixed by neutralization of C1q.
Single injection of anti-C1q did not improve LTP; longer treatment may be needed.

missed_core_items.description: Quantitative mass spectrometry of PSD fractions from 9-month-old Tau-P301S and nonTg mouse hippocampi identified 1,257 unique proteins, with 76 significantly decreased and 45 significantly increased in Tau-P301S PSDs.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: A total of 1,257 unique proteins were identified in the PSD, of which 76 were significantly decreased and 45 significantly increased in Tau-P301S PSD fractions, relative to nonTg (Figure 2A; Table S1).

missed_core_items.description: C1q levels in PSD fractions of Tau-P301S mice were elevated ~9-fold above nonTg controls, whereas in PS2/APP mice they were increased only 2- to 3-fold.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: The average level of C1q in the PSD of Tau-P301S mice was elevated ~9-fold above nonTg controls, whereas it was increased only 2- to 3-fold in the PSD of PS2/APP mice (Figure 4G).

missed_core_items.description: C1q levels in human AD superior frontal gyrus lysates were increased ~1.5-fold in early AD and ~2-fold in AD, and correlated with phospho-Tau (AT8) levels.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: mean levels of C1q in superior frontal gyrus (SFG) lysates were increased ~1.5-fold in patients with a diagnosis of early-stage AD (EAD) and ~2-fold elevated in patients with autopsy-confirmed AD (Figure 5A; Table S3). Like in the Tau-P301S mice, C1q levels were significantly correlated with phospho-Tau (AT8) levels (Figure 5B).

missed_core_items.description: Microglial engulfment of synapses was increased ~2-fold in hippocampal CA1 region of Tau-P301S mice at 9 months, but not at 6 months, as measured by PSD-95 and Synapsin puncta within CD68+ lysosomes.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: we observed an ~2-fold increase in the number of PSD-95 and Synapsin puncta that are located within microglial lysosomes in hippocampal CA1 region from Tau-P301S mice at 9 months, but not at 6 months, of age (Figure 6B).

missed_core_items.description: In neuron-microglia co-cultures, C1q-blocking antibody prevented the loss of PSD-95 puncta along microglia-proximal dendrites of Tau-P301S-transfected neurons, while Gephyrin clusters were unaffected.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: C1q-blocking antibodies, but not IgG isotype control, prevented the loss of PSD-95 puncta along microglia-proximal dendrites (Figures 7A and 7B). The density of Gephyrin clusters was not affected by microglia or by addition of C1q antibodies, further suggesting that microglia selectively remove excitatory synapses without damaging the dendrite (Figures 7A and 7B).

missed_core_items.description: A single injection of C1q-blocking antibody into the hippocampus of 9-month-old Tau-P301S mice resulted in ~50% reduction in PSD-95 or Synapsin puncta within microglial lysosomes and a slight but significant increase in synapse density 5 days post-injection.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: In the ipsilateral CA1 region, the C1q-blocking antibody resulted in ~50% reduction in PSD-95 or Synapsin puncta within microglial lysosomes, as compared to control IgG (Figure 8C) Remarkably, we measured a slight but significant increase in PSD-95 and Synapsin puncta density in CA1 at 5 days after injection of C1q blocking antibody, relative to control IgG (Figure 8D).

research_questions.statement: How does pathological Tau accumulation alter the synaptic proteome and cause synapse loss in tauopathy?

provenance.text_excerpt: Among the most highly upregulated proteins in PSD fractions of Tau-P301S hippocampi was C1q (Figure 2A; Table S1).

claims.statement: C1q accumulates at synapses in Tau-P301S mice and tags them for microglial engulfment, leading to synapse loss.

provenance.text_excerpt: our results demonstrate that C1q antibodies can reduce synapse removal by microglia and lead to a recovery of synapse density in cultures and in vivo.

claims.statement: C1q-blocking antibody reduces microglial synapse engulfment and rescues synapse density in Tau-P301S mice in vivo.

provenance.text_excerpt: Together, these results highlight that the synaptic GTPase-regulating proteins Iqgap1, Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, and Trio are specifically decreased in the PSD compartment of Tau-P301S mice, which can lead to dysregulation of the actin cytoskeleton and potentially contribute to the spine loss seen in AD and other tauopathies.

claims.statement: Pathological Tau accumulation in Tau-P301S mice leads to specific reduction of GTPase-regulatory proteins (Iqgap1, Iqgap2, Iqsec2, Kalirin, Trio) in the postsynaptic density, contributing to spine loss via actin dysregulation.
